description: This file defines the UserNewsResource data class, which extends the NewsResource with additional user-specific information such as follow status, bookmark status, and view status. It also provides a constructor to create a UserNewsResource instance from a NewsResource and UserData, along with an extension function to map a list of NewsResource objects to UserNewsResource objects considering user data.

classes.name: UserNewsResource
classes.description: A data class representing a news resource with user-specific metadata such as follow state, bookmark state, and view status.

methods.name: mapToUserNewsResources
methods.description: An extension function that maps a list of NewsResource objects to a list of UserNewsResource objects using user data.
